nodes.description: Public metadata string identifying contract version (1.0).
Constant bytes32 role hash used for moderator permissions.
Address of the new token contract used in both conversion directions.
Address of the legacy token contract used in both conversion directions.
Boolean flag enabling the convertToOld downgrade flow.
Boolean flag enabling the receiveApproval upgrade flow.
Conversion ratio (default 20) used in both conversion formulas.
msg.sender: caller address used for role checks and token-contract identity checks.
fallback() external payable: accepts ETH, contains no logic.
receive() external payable: accepts ETH, contains no logic.
constructor granting MODERATOR_ROLE to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function granting MODERATOR_ROLE to a new address.
onlyOwner function revoking MODERATOR_ROLE from an address.
onlyModerators function setting oldTokenAddress and newTokenAddress.
Downgrade path called by the new token contract; sends old tokens to owner.
Upgrade path called by the old token contract; pulls old tokens and sends new tokens.
onlyModerators toggle of the downgradable flag.
onlyModerators toggle of the upgradable flag.
onlyModerators update of the conversion ratio.
Modifier requiring hasRole(MODERATOR_ROLE, msg.sender).
AccessControl role membership lookup.
AccessControl grantRole, restricted to the role admin.
AccessControl revokeRole, restricted to the role admin.
Internal _setupRole that grants a role without admin checks.
External oldToken.transfer(_ownerAdd, computedAmount) call in convertToOld.
External newToken.decimals() call feeding the conversion arithmetic.
External oldToken.transferFrom(_ownerAdd, address(this), _value) pull in receiveApproval.
External newToken.transfer(_ownerAdd, computedAmount) push in receiveApproval.
Arithmetic in convertToOld: _amount.div(ratio).div(10**decimals difference).
Arithmetic in receiveApproval: _value.mul(ratio).mul(10**decimals difference).
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue.
Low-level target.call{value: value}(data) in Address.functionCallWithValue.
Low-level target.delegatecall(data) in Address.functionDelegateCall.
Address.sendValue helper performing an ETH transfer through call.
Address.functionCallWithValue helper performing an external call with value.
Address.functionDelegateCall helper performing an external delegatecall.
Ownable.owner() returning the _owner storage variable.
Ownable transferOwnership, guarded by onlyOwner.
Ownable renounceOwnership, guarded by onlyOwner.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender().
_amount: amount to be downgraded in convertToOld.
_ownerAdd: recipient of old tokens in convertToOld.
oldToken: OldToken instance built from oldTokenAddress in convertToOld.
newToken: IERC20 instance built from newTokenAddress in convertToOld.
_ownerAdd: recipient of new tokens in receiveApproval.
_value: amount of old tokens pulled and converted in receiveApproval.
_token: address passed to OldToken in receiveApproval.
_extraData: unused bytes parameter in receiveApproval.
oldToken: OldToken instance built from _token in receiveApproval.
newToken: IERC20 instance built from newTokenAddress in receiveApproval.
_oldTokenAddress: new legacy token address assigned in setAddress.
_newTokenAddress: new token address assigned in setAddress.
_newModerator: address granted MODERATOR_ROLE in AddModerator.
_oldModerator: address losing MODERATOR_ROLE in RemoveModerator.
_downgradable: new value of the downgradable flag.
_upgradable: new value of the upgradable flag.
_ratio: new conversion ratio value.

edges.reason: msg.sender is validated against MODERATOR_ROLE inside onlyModerators.
onlyModerators calls hasRole(MODERATOR_ROLE, msg.sender) to gate execution.
onlyModerators guards setAddress.
onlyModerators guards setDowngradable.
onlyModerators guards setUpgradable.
onlyModerators guards updateRatio.
convertToOld requires msg.sender == newTokenAddress, an address-based access check.
receiveApproval requires msg.sender == oldTokenAddress, an address-based access check.
constructor grants MODERATOR_ROLE to msg.sender, establishing the initial privilege set.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender().
onlyOwner guards AddModerator.
onlyOwner guards RemoveModerator.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
owner() supplies the expected address used in the onlyOwner comparison.
constructor calls _setupRole to initialize roles.
AddModerator calls _setupRole, granting a role without admin checks.
RemoveModerator calls revokeRole to strip a role.
grantRole requires hasRole of the role admin before granting.
revokeRole requires hasRole of the role admin before revoking.
_setupRole writes membership for the MODERATOR_ROLE role.
setAddress writes oldTokenAddress from moderator input.
setAddress writes newTokenAddress from moderator input.
convertToOld reads oldTokenAddress to build the OldToken instance.
convertToOld reads newTokenAddress to build the IERC20 instance.
convertToOld divides the amount by ratio, a moderator-controlled parameter.
convertToOld calls newToken.decimals() to scale the converted amount.
convertToOld performs div and exponent/subtraction arithmetic on decimals and ratio.
convertToOld hands control to the old token contract through transfer before finishing.
isDowngradable modifier checks the downgradable state variable.
receiveApproval reads newTokenAddress for the outgoing new token transfer.
receiveApproval compares msg.sender against oldTokenAddress.
receiveApproval multiplies the value by ratio, a moderator-controlled parameter.
receiveApproval performs mul and exponent/subtraction arithmetic on decimals and ratio.
receiveApproval calls newToken.decimals() to scale the payout.
receiveApproval pulls funds via an external oldToken.transferFrom call before state resolution.
receiveApproval pushes funds via an external newToken.transfer call.
isUpgradable modifier checks the upgradable state variable.
setDowngradable writes the downgradable flag.
setUpgradable writes the upgradable flag.
updateRatio writes the ratio used in conversion arithmetic.
sendValue transfers ETH through recipient.call{value: amount}(""), forwarding all gas.
functionCallWithValue performs target.call{value: value}(data), forwarding control to target.
functionDelegateCall performs target.delegatecall(data), executing untrusted code in this context.
_amount is the dividend of the ratio/decimals division in convertToOld.
_ownerAdd is the recipient argument of the old token transfer.
local oldToken instance is used to perform the external transfer.
local newToken instance is used to call decimals().
_value is the multiplicand of the ratio/decimals multiplication in receiveApproval.
_ownerAdd is the recipient of the new token transfer.
local oldToken instance is used for the external transferFrom pull.
local newToken instance is used for the external transfer push.
parameter _oldTokenAddress is written into oldTokenAddress.
parameter _newTokenAddress is written into newTokenAddress.
_newModerator is the account granted the moderator role.
_oldModerator is the account losing the moderator role.
_downgradable is stored into the downgradable flag.
_upgradable is stored into the upgradable flag.
_ratio is stored into ratio, controlling all conversion arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is only a temporary parameter of convertToOld and can be folded into the function node.
_ownerAdd exists only to be the recipient of the external old token transfer.
the local oldToken instance exists solely to invoke the external transfer call.
the local newToken instance exists solely to invoke the external decimals() call.
_ownerAdd is the beneficiary of the outgoing new token transfer in receiveApproval.
_value is a transient parameter consumed by the receiveApproval arithmetic and transfers.
_token only feeds the OldToken instance used for the external transferFrom pull.
_extraData is unused and belongs entirely to the receiveApproval signature.
the local oldToken instance exists solely to invoke the external transferFrom pull.
the local newToken instance exists solely to invoke the external transfer push.
_oldTokenAddress is directly assigned to the oldTokenAddress state variable inside setAddress.
_newTokenAddress is directly assigned to the newTokenAddress state variable inside setAddress.
_newModerator is the single argument passed to _setupRole inside AddModerator.
_oldModerator is the single argument passed to revokeRole inside RemoveModerator.
_downgradable is written straight into the downgradable state variable.
_upgradable is written straight into the upgradable state variable.
_ratio is written straight into the ratio state variable that drives conversion math.
